title: Frequency Selective Neural Networks as a Foundation Architecture for Time Series Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.29012v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time-series data across physical and biological domains are fundamentally driven by complex, non-stationary oscillatory modes. While deep learning models, such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Recurrent Neural Networks, and Transformers, have dominated sequential analysis, they remain fundamentally "spectral-blind". By mapping continuous physical waves into unconstrained spatial or discrete token spaces, these architectures suffer from severe spectral entanglement, acting as opaque black boxes that decouple predictive accuracy from physical reality. In this paper, we introduce the Frequency Selective Neural Network (FSNN), pioneering a foundation architecture guaranteeing physical interpretability without sacrificing expressive power of deep learning. translated_title: 频率选择神经网络作为时间序列学习的基础架构
translated_abstract: 跨越物理和生物领域的时间序列数据从根本上由复杂、非平稳的振荡模式所驱动。虽然深度学习模型（如卷积神经网络（CNN）、循环神经网络和Transformer）在序列分析中占据主导地位，但它们在本质上仍然是“频谱盲”的。通过将连续的物理波映射到无约束的空间或离散的标记空间中，这些架构遭受严重的频谱纠缠问题，充当着不透明的黑箱，使预测准确性与物理现实相脱钩。在本文中，我们提出了频率选择神经网络（FSNN），开创了一种基础架构，在不牺牲深度学习表达能力的前提下保证物理可解释性。FSNN通过将高级信号处理的严格数学明确嵌入其神经拓扑结构中，来解决频谱纠缠问题。通过一个完全可微分的维纳滤波（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出频率选择神经网络（FSNN），通过将严格的信号处理数学嵌入神经拓扑结构，解决了传统深度学习模型在时间序列建模中的频谱纠缠问题，在保证物理可解释性的同时不牺牲深度学习的表达能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Frequency Selective Neural Network (FSNN), a foundation architecture that embeds rigorous signal-processing mathematics into its neural topology to resolve spectral entanglement in time series learning, guaranteeing physical interpretability without sacrificing the expressive power of deep learning.
